fields.name: density
fields.rationale: Density is a key physical property that affects the handling and application of plaster products. It is explicitly stated in the dataset.

fields.name: gypsum_content
fields.rationale: The dataset describes the product as being based on gypsum, which is a primary component. The phases of gypsum (hemihydrate, anhydrite) are mentioned, indicating varying gypsum content.
evidence: Gipsbinder nach /DIN EN 13279-1/ is the Ausgangsprodukt for the industrielle Herstellung der verschiedenen Gips-Trockenmörtel
inference_basis: Gypsum-based products typically vary in gypsum content, affecting properties like setting time and strength.

fields.name: application_method
fields.rationale: The dataset mentions different application methods such as machine or hand application, which are important for users to know how the product can be applied.
evidence: Gips-Trockenmörtel, Gipsspachtel and Gipskleber can be applied on site or in the factory
inference_basis: Different application methods are common for plaster products, affecting labor and equipment needs.

fields.name: additives_included
fields.rationale: The dataset mentions the inclusion of additives such as setting retarders and cellulose derivatives, which can affect the performance and application of the product.
evidence: Gypsum dry mortars also contain aggregates such as limestone powder, sand or perlite and additives such as setting retarders or cellulose derivatives.
